about:
Ultra Spec Cables Inc is based in Marlboro Township, New Jersey. The company’s founding date and ownership details have not been publicly disclosed.

The company specializes in custom audio/video wall plates, fiber optic assemblies, and Ethernet cables, offering both stocked and made-to-order configurations. Its online platform, FindMyWallPlate.com powered by RiteAV, provides a configuration tool with over 25 A/V jack options and more than 75 color choices. Ultra Spec Cables also offers precision engraving on wall plates and ships worldwide from its New Jersey facility.

Ultra Spec Cables serves customers ranging from home theater enthusiasts purchasing Xbox 360 component cables to professionals requiring custom fiber assemblies for networking installations. The product catalog includes both standard AV cables and made-to-order fiber solutions, supporting residential and commercial AV projects.

The company emphasizes its broad selection of customizable wall plates, an intuitive online design tool, and quick turnaround from its New Jersey location, positioning itself as a one-stop source for AV connectivity and fiber infrastructure. Worldwide shipping with customs fees and taxes prepaid is also highlighted.
